final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref AS project_id, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), total AS (SELECT SUM(qc_count) AS total_count FROM project_counts), fractions AS (SELECT p.project_id, p.qc_count, CAST(p.qc_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS fraction FROM project_counts AS p CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_fraction AS (SELECT AVG(fraction) AS avg_fraction FROM fractions) SELECT f.project_id, f.qc_count, f.fraction, f.fraction - a.avg_fraction AS difference FROM fractions AS f CROSS JOIN average_fraction AS a WHERE a.avg_fraction IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
